dmTitle.infoName: Removal and Installation – Display and Recording Units

proceduralStep.title: Display Unit Removal
proceduralStep.para: WARNING: Observe ESD precautions. Wear grounded wrist strap throughout procedure.
De-energize aircraft electrical system. Verify power OFF at display unit.
Remove bezels or covers providing access to display unit mounting screws.
Disconnect electrical connectors from rear of display unit. Support connector bodies, not cables.
Remove mounting screws (typically 4-6 screws). Retain hardware for installation.
Carefully withdraw display unit from instrument panel. Support unit weight; do not allow to drop or swing.
Place removed display unit in anti-static bag. Store in protective packaging.
Remove replacement display unit from protective packaging. Inspect for shipping damage.
Inspect mounting tray and connectors in aircraft for cleanliness and damage.
Carefully insert display unit into mounting tray. Align mounting holes.
Connect electrical connectors. Verify positive engagement (should hear/feel click).
Install and torque mounting screws to 25-30 in-lb. Use cross-pattern tightening sequence.
Install bezels and covers.
Apply aircraft power and verify display unit powers up and passes self-test.
Perform functional check per DMC-AMPEL360-31-00-00-520B.
Update aircraft configuration records with new display unit serial number and software version.

proceduralStep.title: Flight Data Recorder (FDR) Removal
proceduralStep.para: CAUTION: FDR contains crash-protected data. Handle as evidence if aircraft involved in accident/incident.
De-energize FDR circuit breaker.
Access FDR mounting location (aft pressure bulkhead).
Disconnect electrical connector and RF connector (underwater locator beacon antenna).
Remove mounting fasteners (typically 4 bolts). Note orientation of unit for installation reference.
Remove FDR unit. CAUTION: Unit weighs approximately 15-20 lbs.
If data preservation required, store FDR in temperature-controlled environment and maintain chain of custody.
Inspect replacement FDR for shipping damage and verify correct part number.
Verify tamper-evident seals intact on FDR.
Position FDR in mounting tray with correct orientation.
Install mounting fasteners and torque to 150-180 in-lb.
Connect electrical connector and RF connector.
Close access panels.
Apply power and verify FDR status shows ACTIVE with no fault codes.
Perform FDR functional test per DMC-AMPEL360-31-00-00-520A.
Update aircraft records with new FDR serial number and installation date.

proceduralStep.title: Quick Access Recorder (QAR) Memory Module Replacement
proceduralStep.para: NOTE: This is a simple task performable by flight crew or line maintenance.
Access QAR unit (typically forward electronics bay or cockpit overhead panel).
Open QAR access door.
Depress release latch and withdraw memory module.
Insert replacement memory module. Push firmly until latch engages (audible click).
Close access door.
Verify QAR status shows ACTIVE and recording in progress.
